  #header h1 { font-size:14px; color:#C9A227; letter-spacing:0.5px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.3; }
  #header p { font-size:9.5px; color:#9FBCAC; margin-top:1px; }
  #menuBtn { display:none; background:#1A3826; border:1px solid #2A5535; color:#C9A227; border-radius:6px; width:36px; height:36px; font-size:18px; cursor:pointer; flex-shrink:0; }
  #locateBtn { background:#1A3826; border:1px solid #2A5535; color:#C9A227; border-radius:6px; padding:6px 10px; font-size:10.5px; cursor:pointer; margin-left:8px; flex-shrink:0; white-space:nowrap; }

  #main { display:flex; flex:1; overflow:hidden; position:relative; }
  #map { flex:1; background:#0B1F14; min-width:0; }

  #panel { width:340px; background:#0B1F14; overflow-y:auto; border-left:1px solid #2A5535; flex-shrink:0; }
  #panel::-webkit-scrollbar { width:6px; }
  #panel::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background:#0B1F14; }
  #panel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:#2A5535; border-radius:3px; }

  .panel-section { padding:9px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid #1A3826; }
  .panel-section h3 { font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.4px; margin-bottom:7px; padding-bottom:5px; border-bottom:1px solid #2A5535; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; }

  .layer-toggle { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:5px 2px; cursor:pointer; border-radius:4px; }
  .layer-toggle:hover, .layer-toggle:active { background:#1A3826; }
  .layer-toggle input[type=checkbox] { width:15px; height:15px; min-width:15px; cursor:pointer; accent-color:#C9A227; }
  .swatch { width:11px; height:11px; min-width:11px; border-radius:2px; pointer-events:none; }
  .layer-name { font-size:10.5px; flex:1; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
  .layer-count { font-size:9px; color:#7BB89A; flex-shrink:0; }

  .sub-list::-webkit-scrollbar { width:5px; }
  .sub-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:#2A5535; border-radius:3px; }

  #info { position:absolute; bottom:16px; left:12px; z-index:1000; background:#0D2A18ee; border:1px solid #C9A227; border-radius:8px; padding:9px 13px; max-width:min(290px, 70vw); font-size:11px; display:none; pointer-events:none; }
  #info h4 { color:#C9A227; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:3px; }
  #info p { color:#AADDBB; line-height:1.45; }
  #info .badge { display:inline-block; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:4px; font-size:9.5px; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:4px; margin-right:3px; }

  .search-box { width:100%; padding:6px 8px; background:#132A1B; border:1px solid #2A5535; border-radius:5px; color:white; font-size:10.5px; margin-bottom:6px; }
  .search-box::placeholder { color:#5F8570; }

  #overlay { display:none; position:absolute; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index:1050; }

  .leaflet-control-layers { background:#0D2A18 !important; color:#EAF4EE !important; border:1px solid #2A5535 !important; }
  .leaflet-control-layers-toggle { filter: invert(1) hue-rotate(80deg); }

  /* ---- Tutorial / Legenda ---- */
  #tutorial-banner { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0D2A18,#16351F); border-bottom:2px solid #C9A227; padding:10px 14px; flex-shrink:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  #tutorial-banner.hidden { display:none; }

  #reopenTutorial { display:none; background:#1A3826; border:1px solid #2A5535; color:#C9A227; border-radius:6px; padding:6px 9px; font-size:10.5px; cursor:pointer; margin-left:8px; flex-shrink:0; }

<div id="header">
  <div>
    <h1>CAND. DEP. FEDERAL OZÓRIO JUVENIL 1025</h1>
    <p>63 Terras Indígenas · 110 UCs (59 federais · 35 estaduais · 16 municipais)</p>
  </div>
  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;">
    <button id="reopenTutorial" onclick="showTutorial()">❔ Legenda</button>
    <button id="locateBtn" onclick="locatePara()">📍 Pará</button>
    <button id="menuBtn" onclick="togglePanel()">☰</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="tutorial-banner">
  <div>
    <div class="legend-row">
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch" style="background:#C9A227;"></span> Terras Indígenas</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch" style="background:#2ECC71;"></span> UCs Federais</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch" style="background:#3498DB;"></span> UCs Estaduais</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch" style="background:#E67E22;"></span> UCs Municipais</span>
      <span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch line" style="border-color:#EAF4EE;"></span> Contorno do Pará</span>
    </div>
    <div id="tutorial-text">Marque as caixas no painel à direita (☰ no celular) para mostrar cada camada. Toque num polígono para ver nome, categoria e área.</div>
  </div>
  <button id="closeTutorial" onclick="hideTutorial()">Entendi ✕</button>
</div>

<div id="main">
  <div id="map"></div>
  <div id="overlay" onclick="togglePanel()"></div>
  <div id="panel">

    <div class="panel-section">
      <details class="help">
        <summary>Como usar este mapa</summary>
        <p>
          • Nada aparece marcado por padrão — marque as caixas abaixo para exibir cada camada.<br>
          • O botão "Todas" liga/desliga a categoria inteira de uma vez.<br>
          • Cada item também tem sua própria caixa, para marcar/desmarcar individualmente.<br>
          • Toque em qualquer polígono colorido no mapa para ver nome, categoria e área.<br>
          • Use a busca em cada seção para achar um nome rapidamente.<br>
          • Troque o mapa de fundo (Satélite/Ruas) no ícone de camadas, no canto superior direito do mapa.
        </p>
      </details>
    </div>

    <div class="panel-section">
      <h3>◆ LIMITE DO ESTADO</h3>
      <div class="layer-toggle" style="opacity:0.75;cursor:default;">
        <input type="checkbox" id="chk-pa" checked disabled>
        <div class="swatch" style="background:transparent;border:2px solid #EAF4EE;"></div>
        <span class="layer-name">Contorno do Pará</span>
        <span class="cat-tag">sempre ativo</span>
      </div>
      <div class="layer-toggle" style="opacity:0.75;cursor:default;">
        <input type="checkbox" id="chk-mun" checked disabled>
        <div class="swatch" style="background:transparent;border:1px solid #5F8570;"></div>
        <span class="layer-name">Limites municipais (144)</span>
        <span class="cat-tag">sempre ativo</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel-section">
      <h3>★ TERRAS INDÍGENAS <span class="layer-count">63</span></h3>
      <div class="layer-toggle">
        <input type="checkbox" id="chk-ti-all" onchange="toggleGroupAll('ti',this.checked)">
        <div class="swatch" style="background:#C9A227;"></div>
        <span class="layer-name"><b>Todas as TIs</b></span>
      </div>
      <input class="search-box" placeholder="Buscar TI..." oninput="filterList('ti-list', this.value)">
      <div class="sub-list" id="ti-list"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel-section">
      <h3>🇧🇷 UCs FEDERAIS <span class="layer-count">59</span></h3>
      <div class="layer-toggle">
        <input type="checkbox" id="chk-fed-all" onchange="toggleGroupAll('fed',this.checked)">
        <div class="swatch" style="background:#2ECC71;"></div>
        <span class="layer-name"><b>Todas as UCs federais</b></span>
      </div>
      <input class="search-box" placeholder="Buscar UC federal..." oninput="filterList('fed-list', this.value)">
      <div class="sub-list" id="fed-list"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel-section">
      <h3>🏞 UCs ESTADUAIS <span class="layer-count">35</span></h3>
      <div class="layer-toggle">
        <input type="checkbox" id="chk-est-all" onchange="toggleGroupAll('est',this.checked)">
        <div class="swatch" style="background:#3498DB;"></div>
        <span class="layer-name"><b>Todas as UCs estaduais</b></span>
      </div>
      <input class="search-box" placeholder="Buscar UC estadual..." oninput="filterList('est-list', this.value)">
      <div class="sub-list" id="est-list"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel-section">
      <h3>🏘 UCs MUNICIPAIS <span class="layer-count">16</span></h3>
      <div class="layer-toggle">
        <input type="checkbox" id="chk-mnp-all" onchange="toggleGroupAll('mnp',this.checked)">
        <div class="swatch" style="background:#E67E22;"></div>
        <span class="layer-name"><b>Todas as UCs municipais</b></span>
      </div>
      <input class="search-box" placeholder="Buscar UC municipal..." oninput="filterList('mnp-list', this.value)">
      <div class="sub-list" id="mnp-list"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel-section">
      <h3>📋 FONTES</h3>
      <div style="font-size:9.5px;color:#6A9A7A;line-height:1.7">
        • IBGE — Malha Municipal 2025<br>
        • FUNAI — tis_poligonais.shp<br>
        • CNUC — ICMBio/MMA, 03/2026<br>
        • Categorias: APA, RESEX, FLONA/Floresta Estadual, PARNA/Parque Estadual, ESEC, REBIO, RVS, RDS, RPPN, ARIE, Monumento Natural<br>
        • Geometrias simplificadas para exibição web
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

-0.9434753999999543],[-46.60275679999995,-0.9407004999999344],[-46.60638549999993,-0.9551472999999646],[-46.624618699999985,-0.953680899999938]]],[[[-46.14967169999994,-0.9540478999999777],[-46.15213389999997,-0.925229599999966],[-46.137234099999944,-0.9268208999999388],[-46.14967169999994,-0.9540478999999777]]],[[[-46.46023409999998,-0.9144242999999506],[-46.46200299999998,-0.9080864999999676],[-46.45642829999997,-0.906813599999964],[-46.46023409999998,-0.9144242999999506]]],[[[-46.72211149999998,-0.7825774999999453],[-46.72373719999996,-0.7900364999999283],[-46.729335599999956,-0.7831117999999719],[-46.72211149999998,-0.7825774999999453]]]]}}]};

const map = L.map('map', { zoomControl:true, attributionControl:false });

const baseSat  = L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', { maxZoom: 18 });
const baseRuas = L.tileLayer('https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Street_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', { maxZoom: 19 });
baseSat.addTo(map);
L.control.layers({ "Satélite": baseSat, "Ruas": baseRuas }, null, { position:'topright', collapsed:true }).addTo(map);

const layerPara = L.geoJSON(paData, { style: { color:'#EAF4EE', weight:3, fillColor:'#EAF4EE', fillOpacity:0.03 } }).addTo(map);
map.fitBounds(layerPara.getBounds(), { padding:[20,20] });
function locatePara() { map.fitBounds(layerPara.getBounds(), { padding:[20,20] }); }

function togglePanel() {
  document.getElementById('panel').classList.toggle('open');
  document.getElementById('overlay').classList.toggle('show');
}
function showInfo(html) { const i=document.getElementById('info'); i.innerHTML=html; i.style.display='block'; }
function hideInfo() { document.getElementById('info').style.display = 'none'; }

function hideTutorial() {
  document.getElementById('tutorial-banner').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('reopenTutorial').style.display = 'inline-block';
  try { localStorage.setItem('tutorialSeen', '1'); } catch(e) {}
}
function showTutorial() {
  document.getElementById('tutorial-banner').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('reopenTutorial').style.display = 'none';
}

// ---- Municípios (começa DESMARCADO) ----
const layerMun = L.geoJSON(munData, {
  style: { color:'#5F8570', weight:0.8, fillOpacity:0, opacity:0.7 },
  onEachFeature: (f, l) => l.on('click', () => showInfo(`<h4>${f.properties.NM_MUN}</h4><p>Município do Pará</p>`))
}).addTo(map); // sempre ativo, não pode ser desmarcado

// ---- TIs ----
const tiLayers = {};
const tiGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
tiData.features.forEach((f, i) => {
  const id = 'ti-'+i;
  const l = L.geoJSON(f, { style: { color:'#C9A227', weight:1.2, fillColor:'#C9A227', fillOpacity:0.35 } });
  l.on('click', () => showInfo(`<span class="badge" style="background:#C9A227;color:#0B1F14;">TI</span><h4>${f.properties.nome}</h4><p>Etnia: ${f.properties.etnia||'—'}<br>Área: ${f.properties.area_ha ? f.properties.area_ha.toLocaleString('pt-BR')+' ha' : '—'}<br>Fase: ${f.properties.fase||'—'}</p>`));
  tiLayers[id] = l;
});

// ---- UCs por esfera ----
const fedFeatures = ucData.features.filter(f => f.properties.esfera === 'Federal');
const estFeatures = ucData.features.filter(f => f.properties.esfera === 'Estadual');
const mnpFeatures = ucData.features.filter(f => f.properties.esfera === 'Municipal');

const fedLayers = {}, estLayers = {}, mnpLayers = {};
const fedGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
const estGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
const mnpGroup = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);

function buildUcLayer(f, id, color, store) {
  const l = L.geoJSON(f, { style: { color: color, weight:1, fillColor: color, fillOpacity:0.32 } });
  l.on('click', () => showInfo(`<span class="badge" style="background:${color};color:#0B1F14;">${f.properties.esfera}</span><span class="badge" style="background:#2A5535;color:#EAF4EE;">${f.properties.grupo}</span><h4>${f.properties.nome}</h4><p>Categoria: ${f.properties.categoria||'—'}<br>Área: ${f.properties.area_ha ? Math.round(f.properties.area_ha).toLocaleString('pt-BR')+' ha' : '—'}</p>`));
  store[id] = l;
}
fedFeatures.forEach((f,i) => buildUcLayer(f, 'fed-'+i, '#2ECC71', fedLayers));
estFeatures.forEach((f,i) => buildUcLayer(f, 'est-'+i, '#3498DB', estLayers));
mnpFeatures.forEach((f,i) => buildUcLayer(f, 'mnp-'+i, '#E67E22', mnpLayers));

const REGISTRY = {
  'ti': { layers: tiLayers, group: tiGroup },
  'fed': { layers: fedLayers, group: fedGroup },
  'est': { layers: estLayers, group: estGroup },
  'mnp': { layers: mnpLayers, group: mnpGroup },
};

function toggleGroupAll(prefix, checked) {
  const { layers, group } = REGISTRY[prefix];
  Object.keys(layers).forEach(id => {
    const cb = document.getElementById('cb-'+id);
    if (cb) cb.checked = checked;
    if (checked) { if(!group.hasLayer(layers[id])) group.addLayer(layers[id]); }
    else { group.removeLayer(layers[id]); }
  });
}
function toggleOne(prefix, id, checked) {
  const { layers, group } = REGISTRY[prefix];
  if (checked) { if(!group.hasLayer(layers[id])) group.addLayer(layers[id]); }
  else { group.removeLayer(layers[id]); }
  // se desmarcar um item, o "Todas" correspondente também desmarca
  if (!checked) {
    const allCb = document.getElementById('chk-'+prefix+'-all');
    if (allCb) allCb.checked = false;
  }
}
function buildList(containerId, prefix, features, color) {
  const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  const rows = [];
  features.forEach((f, i) => {
    const id = prefix+'-'+i;
    const name = f.properties.nome || '(sem nome)';
    const cat = f.properties.categoria || '';
    rows.push('<div class="layer-toggle" data-name="'+(name.toLowerCase()+' '+cat.toLowerCase())+'">'+
      '<input type="checkbox" id="cb-'+id+'" onchange="toggleOne(\''+prefix+'\',\''+id+'\',this.checked)">'+
      '<div class="swatch" style="background:'+color+';"></div>'+
      '<span class="layer-name" title="'+name+'">'+name+'</span>'+
      '<span class="cat-tag">'+cat+'</span>'+
    '</div>');
  });
  container.innerHTML = rows.join('');
}
buildList('ti-list', 'ti', tiData.features, '#C9A227');
buildList('fed-list', 'fed', fedFeatures, '#2ECC71');
buildList('est-list', 'est', estFeatures, '#3498DB');
buildList('mnp-list', 'mnp', mnpFeatures, '#E67E22');

function filterList(containerId, query) {
  const q = query.toLowerCase();
  document.querySelectorAll('#'+containerId+' .layer-toggle').forEach(el => {
    el.style.display = el.dataset.name.includes(q) ? 'flex' : 'none';
  });
}

if (window.innerWidth > 760) { document.getElementById('panel').classList.add('open'); }

// esconde o tutorial automaticamente se a pessoa já viu antes (localStorage)
try {
  if (localStorage.getItem('tutorialSeen') === '1') { hideTutorial(); }
} catch(e) {}
</script>
</body>
</html>
